gates.detail: The public build lists 160 camps: 73 confident Parks SA campgrounds, 7 approximate Street View Parks SA campgrounds, and the council, community and showground camps from the approved list. 86 commercial caravan, holiday and tourist parks are excluded. 19 parks whose ownership is unconfirmed are left out.
Live parks.sa.gov.au HTML is not parsed. This launch uses the saved notice file from the approved list.
Pink Gum way/1192258723 is one camp. Its camp_pitch children are not camps. Geometry is not an entrance.
Current site CC BY 3.0 AU, legacy JSON CC BY 4.0 and OSM ODbL stay separate. No booking prose or photos.
The public build uses SA_FIRE_MODE=linkout. Pages link to the SA Country Fire Service and do not publish a district rating or the fire-ban polygons. A total fire ban does not close a camp.
Notices are the saved Adelaide windows from the approved list. A camp is closed, partial, upcoming or unknown only where a notice says so. No current notice is not a confirmation the camp is open.
No SA segment is created. Signup stays off. Pages say the weekly email is coming soon.
The Victoria, New South Wales and Queensland build and tests run with this activation.
